description: Low-pass gate: a filter and a VCA opening together, either held open by a knob or pinged by a trigger

params.text: Opens the gate, raising the filter and the level together; with a cable in PING it is not read at all
Sets how much high end passes through the closing gate, lifts the filter a little and lengthens the decay tail
Sets how long the gate takes to close after a ping

inputs.text: The signal passing through the gate
A rising edge fires the decay envelope that opens and closes the gate
Adds to the LEVEL knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held between shut and fully open; with a cable in PING it is not read at all
Adds to the COLOR knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the DECAY knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits

notes: With nothing patched into PING the gate is held open by the LEVEL knob and its CV; patching PING hands the opening over to the envelope and LEVEL stops being read.
